description: tools/test-projects/input (WEB_PROJECT=input tools/build.sh web): ?input-script=/scripts/menu.input.json is a URL, which the page fetches from its own origin before the engine starts (input-recorder-and-input-scripts R30); the gate serves the menu script there ("serve"), so the run replays it as the content path does: the click, the done line and exit code 0, in order.
